The comment in the third(3) range is incorrect and serves a selfish purpose. It attempts to confuse people in order to divert funds during a withdrawal attempt, as was the case with puzzles 66 and 69, where a transaction was intercepted using RBF in the public mempool. The fund withdrawal guide was written based on the input from experienced and knowledgeable individuals. I am attaching links from Bitcointalk: https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=1306983.msg64379149#msg64379149 and https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=1306983.msg65255375#msg65255375. Based on these posts, a step-by-step guide with examples and pictures was created. Good luck to everyone! And first and foremost, use your own head, not the comments of unknown people...

RBF = true means the transaction is replaceable. The issue is that when the transaction is broadcast, the public key is revealed. Within a few seconds someone could derive the private key and double-spend the funds. Anyway, as said, use your own brain or ask your preferred AI. The idea behind this site is good, but not entirely honest. Good luck everyone! Donation address: 1HooooooooooLprshiHCKDfH5vCDPdp8FQ
